text.p: Colombia's industrial output, excluding coffee processing, in the first 11 months of 1996 fell 3.35 percent compared to the same period in 1995, the National Statistics Department said in a statement Tuesday.
The fall in November alone was 11.35 percent compared to November 1995, the statement said.
The biggest falls in output were recorded in the transport equipment, chemicals, paper, soft drinks and non-metal minerals sectors, the statistics department said.

The largest rises in production were seen in the oil, food, textiles and clothing sectors. Professional and scientific equipment and non-processed food production, meanwhile, grew in 1996 but at a slower rate than in 1995, the report stated.
